raw_tokens.value: An Aldori swordlord adds a +%1 bonus on Intimidate checks while using Dazzling Display with an Aldori dueling sword. He also gains an additional +1 bonus on these Intimidate checks for each of the following feats he has with the Aldori dueling sword: Greater Weapon Focus, Greater Weapon Specialization, Improved Critical, Weapon Focus, or Weapon Specialization. The bonuses stack with each other (the total bonus is considered a competence bonus). When involved in a duel, an Aldori swordlord's mastery of elaborate strikes and stances grants him a +%1 bonus on performance combat checks (Ultimate Combat 154). These tricks can also be of great help in countering an enemy during a duel, granting him a +%1 bonus on rolls to attempt a dueling parry or to use dueling resolve (Ultimate Combat 152).|AldoriSwordlordLVL/2
